question: Which Indian dancer won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for Chhau Dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapan Kumar Pattanayak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tapan Kumar Pattanayak** won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for Chhau Dance.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is a prestigious recognition given to individuals for their outstanding contribution to the field of performing arts in India.
 
• Chhau Dance is a traditional Indian dance form that combines martial arts, acrobatics, and storytelling.
 
• The award highlights the significant contributions of artists in preserving and promoting traditional dance forms like Chhau.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Sangeet Natak Akademi** is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It was set up by the Government of India in 1952 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• The Akademi aims to promote and preserve the cultural heritage of India by recognizing and supporting artists in various fields of performing arts.
 
• Recipients of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award are selected by a jury of experts in the respective fields.
 
• The award not only brings recognition but also encourages the artists to continue their dedicated work in their art forms.
